author: louise scothern
content: USB events supplied a slide bouncy castle for my son's fifth birthday party. They were extremely professional throughout the booking process and great at answering all my questions. On the day they were absolutely fantastic. The driver arrived in plenty of time and got on with setting up the bouncy castle as we frantically prepared the party. The bouncy castle itself was cleaned once it was inflated and was immaculate. Prompt pick up and an extremely friendly service. I would highly recommend booking with USB events for your kids' birthday parties.
